apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Move a game to another season: open the game and tap "Move to another
  season…" at the bottom. The score, stats and play-by-play go with it.
  Handy for games your player played for another team: make a season for
  that team and move them there. A moved guest game stops being marked as
  a guest game

- Save button at the top of the game form, so there's no scrolling to save
- The selected tournament is shown in green with a check mark
- Swiping back from the left edge no longer leaves the page stuck
  part-scrolled with the header missing
- Swiping back from a game form with unsaved changes now asks before
  discarding them

- Results on a season's Events tab are now in boxes: Regular season, each
  tournament, and Friendlies, each with its record and number of games
- Tap a box's header to collapse or expand it; the app remembers which
  ones you collapsed for each season

- Saved tournaments are one tap: pick Tournament on a game and the
  season's tournaments show as buttons. Switching a game to Tournament picks
  the latest one automatically, so you only type a name once
- "League" is now called "Regular season"

- Game types inside a season: League, Tournament or Friendly (set it in a
  game's Edit). Tournament games get a tournament name, e.g. Fall Classic
- The Events tab can filter by type, and each tournament's results are
  grouped together with that tournament's record
- The season's record and standings count league games only; the Stats tab
  shows a record for the league and each tournament
- Finish scoring without going back to the Events list: Done on the scoring
  screen asks to finish, and the recap has a Finish scoring button

apps.name: Soccer Stats Beta
apps.subtitle: Test builds of upcoming features
apps.localizedDescription: Test builds of Soccer Stats with features that aren’t released yet. Installs alongside the normal app.

versions.localizedDescription: New Live Activity look (app name, LIVE/FINAL, logos), game clock with minutes per half, opponent logos.
Tap the live score to open the scoring screen. After Done, the final score stays on the lock screen for 30 minutes.
Fix: the live score code wasn't connected. The scoring screen now shows a small 'Live:' status next to Done.
